org.opentmf.client:opentmf-clients-base 1.1.5 发布, OpenTMF Clients Base is a TMF-630 compliant generic client implementation which uses Spring's
		reactive WebClient to communicate with a TMF compliant backend.

		The following features are provided out of the box:
		- Uses the dynamically decomposable tmf-models library for the hierarchical TMF model classes.
		- Supports dnext-tmf-models and sh-tmf-models extensions.
		- Ability to use any configured pia-web-clients for dynamic access token retrieval
		- Ability to specify only the requested columns
		- Ability to apply a jsonPath at server-side or client-side
		- Ability to retrieve a payload as the desired object type
		- Ability to retrieve one page, all pages at once, or any desired page at a time
		- Provides methods with and without access token parameters
		- Follows TMF-630 recommendations.

items.title:
org.glassfish.metro:wsrx-project 4.0.5 发布, Metro is a high-performance, extensible, easy-to-use web service stack.
        It is a one-stop shop for all your web service needs, from the simplest
        hello world web service to reliable, secured, and transacted web service
        that involves .NET services.

        Metro consists of JAX-WS Reference Implementation project and
        Web Services Interoperability Technology project.

        JAX-WS Reference Implementation (JAX-WS RI) provides core web servicing
        support and the base framework for extensions provided by the WSIT layer.

        Web Services Interoperability Technologies (WSIT) (previously known as
        Project Tango) includes implementations of:
        - SOAP over TCP
        - WS-AtomicTransactions/Coordination
        - WS-MetadataExchange
        - WS-Policy (github.com/eclipse-ee4j/metro-policy)
        - WS-ReliableMessaging
        - WS-SecureConversation
        - WS-Security
        - WS-SecurityPolicy
        - WS-Trust

        Note:
        - WS-Policy (github.com/eclipse-ee4j/metro-policy)
        has its own codebase however WS-Policy related issues can be submitted into
        the Metro (WSIT) Issue tracker

        that involves .NET services.

        Metro consists of JAX-WS Reference Implementation project and
        Web Services Interoperability Technology project.

        support and the base framework for extensions provided by the WSIT layer.

        Project Tango) includes implementations of:

        - WS-Trust
